CustomField.description: Pipeline Health: Close Confidence Change Indicator. Close Confidence field. Input fields are written by Momentum from call content and formula fields are derived from them.
CustomField.formula: IF( Close_Likelihood_Score__c < Prior_Health_Score__c, "LOWER", IF( Close_Likelihood_Score__c > Prior_Health_Score__c, "HIGHER", "UNCHANGED" ) )
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Close Confidence signal. Input fields come from Momentum, formulas are derived. Treat as a signal, not a commitment.
CustomField.label: Close Confidence Change Indicator
